neighbours.label: the piece 'au' after H, Kl or G in names: H|au|ke, H|au|fler, h|au|k, Kl|au; not after longer stems as in Lind|au
fire: Birgit Hauke of Lakeside Farms spoke at length.
Patients were treated at the Haukeland hospital in Bergen.
Juha Haukka wrote the report on suicide statistics.
Habitat goals were set (Haufler et al. 2011) in Kansas.
Counts follow the method of Haukos and Smith.
Compare the Old Norse form with Frisian hauk.
My neighbor Peter Klau sold the car.
The old German word Gau means a district.
quiet: Birgit Holt of Lakeside Farms spoke at length.
Patients were treated at the Lindau hospital in Bavaria.
Juha Heller wrote the report on suicide statistics.
Habitat goals were set (Hoffer et al. 2011) in Kansas.
Counts follow the method of Hobart and Smith.
Compare the Old Norse form with Frisian hoek.
My neighbor Peter Dachau sold the car.
The old German word Passau means nothing.

notes: A tokenizer check shows the piece appears only for some spellings: 'Hauser', 'Haugen' and 'Hauck' split as ' Ha|...', so they were left out.
